summary: Freightos Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing preliminary third-quarter 2026 platform KPIs ahead of full results due November 23, 2026. Q3 transactions reached 494 thousand, up 15% year-over-year versus guidance of 481-490 thousand, while gross booking value hit a record $437 million, up 30% year-over-year against expectations of $390-397 million. Active carriers rose to 79 from 75 in Q2 2026, and unique buyer users totaled roughly 21,900. The release cites elevated freight rates, tight capacity and higher fuel costs. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation or advisor is involved; this is routine operational disclosure.
